name: @3ngram/server
description: MCP server and REST API for persistent, typed AI-agent memory.
comment:exports: Side-effect-free seams ONLY. `./app` exposes createApp so a downstream composition root can compose the server; `./boot` exposes the shared fail-closed bootstrap() (initObservability -> loadEnv -> metered-op + OAuth key checks -> dynamic-import createApp + listen) so both entrypoints run the IDENTICAL boot and cannot drift. `./mailer` exposes the SMTP sender (loadSmtpConfig + nodemailer, degrade-to-noop) so one mail transport is reused for dunning instead of re-wiring nodemailer. Importing any of these has NO side effects -- transports/boot run only when their function is called. src/index.ts stays the sole side-effectful entry and is intentionally NOT exported.
